title: བསྟན་འགྱུར། སྡེ་དགེ། དབུ་མ། ཀི (Derge Tengyur, vol. 110)
shelf_note: A Derge woodblock folio in the Madhyamaka section quoting the Vimalakīrtinirdeśa (Vimalakīrti's sermon on the body), the kind of sūtra citation Madhyamaka anthologies carry; it belongs on this shelf.

tr_errors_A.english: this body is a vessel of many afflictions
tr_errors_A.problem: ནད is 'disease'; 'afflictions' blurs it with ཉོན་མོངས, which appears two lines later

tr_errors_B.english: this body is unbearable, like a mass of foam
tr_errors_B.problem: ཅང་མི་བཟོད་པ here means 'cannot withstand (pressure)', i.e. frail, not 'unbearable'; the simile loses its point

pages.prefer_reason: Both are faithful and complete, but B drops the name Vaiśālī and renders ཅང་མི་བཟོད་པ as 'unbearable', while A has only a minor wording slip.

book_verdict: The folio's transcription matches the woodblock line for line, from the opening ཐབས་ལ་མཁས་པས to the final ཡང, and both translations render Vimalakīrti's similes for the body faithfully; A is the slightly better of the two.
